content:
maya: Cost ops flagged a retention spike again; wanted to sync on long-term approach. This thread captures design and rollout plan.

raj: short version: move to an edge-friendly adaptive sampler + minimal ingress header so we can sample before enrichment while preserving billing attribution.

katie: quick datapoint: top 3 tenants accounted for 68% of retention bytes last month. Two of them log large debug blobs into span baggage.

ingest-bot: note: enrichment pipeline runs asynchronously; billing join sometimes misses short-lived traces.

raj: design constraints:
- no PII in header
- header size < 64 bytes
- backward compatible with current proxies
- keep a 48h grace retention for un-attributed traces

katie: operational metrics required: sampling_precision, attribution_gap_rate, retention_bytes_by_tenant, billing_lookup_missing, cost_estimate_preview. Dashboards must allow cohort comparisons.

privacy-bot: recommended header format: tenant GUID + version + hmac. If higher trust needed, use KMS-signed token.

maya: prototype plan:
- raj: build wasm proxy sampler that reads header and sets sampled=true
- raj: collector change to honor sampled marker and keep full trace payload
- katie: dashboards and runbook
- tim: privacy/KMS note and escalation path

tim: experiment cohorts:
- cohort 1 (header+edge sampling) -> 5% traffic
- cohort 2 (collector heuristic sampling) -> 5% traffic
- control -> no sampling changes

maya: run length 2 weeks. success criteria: >30% reduction in retention bytes for cohort 1 with attribution_precision > 99% and billing_lookup_missing < 0.05%

katie: runbook snippets: if billing_lookup_missing spikes, revert cohort and increase retention TTL for affected tenant; call billing ops.

raj: engineering risks: header spoofing -> mitigate with HMAC; header rotation complexity; some language runtimes may not add header easily (serverless).

maya: timeline: prototype and internal review (1 week), privacy review (2nd week), canary rollout (week 3).

katie: will add cost-impact preview graphs for the top tenants; will also add a per-tenant estimated monthly savings card to the billing UI for the canary.

maya: thanks. I'll consolidate notes and create a short RFC follow-up doc after the canary completes.
